==Notes==
* Kupofried's corundum are similar to [[voidstone]]s used exclusively for [[Provenance]]: once you have obtained the first (in exchange for one [[voidstone]]), they will regenerate automatically at a rate of one per 24 hours and will be held by Kupofried at the glimmering ??? in [[Walk of Echoes]].
* You can receive one additional corundum for every four [[Crystal Petrifact]]s traded to the glimmering ???. You can hold up to three [[Kupofried's corundum]] at once, but Kupofried will retain additional stock if you trade extra [[Crystal Petrifact]]s.
* Kupofried's corundum are required to enter the [[Provenance Crystal]] battlefields in [[Provenance]]: [[Beguiling Radiance]], [[Maddening Radiance]], and [[Seductive Radiance]]. They are not required for the [[Provenance Watcher]] battle.
